text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... There are no blank pages left.
Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much...
"Chrono Genesis pulls out a new file from the cabinet. Her handmade documents are now permanent residents of the trainer's office."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! The sheer number of articles
on Ai-san's Dubai conquest is incredible, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It's easy to see
just how shocking that run truly was.

Almond Eye conquered
the international GⅠ race in Dubai.

Media outlets from around the world praised her running,
bestowing upon her the title of the world's number one Umamusume.

The racing world is buzzing with talk of Almond Eye.
Overturning this trend looks like it'll be tough.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Still, reading the international articles...
it seems my "Genesis Factor" wasn't far off the mark.
choice_data_list: (The Genesis Factor. If I recall correctly...)

text_block_list.text:
Her "crucial historical-drama elements to consider"
when it comes to predicting winning Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
In racing, outcomes sometimes emerge
as if guided by history itself.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Their devotion to the GⅠ, the clash between fated rivals,
the intertwined destinies of Umamusume, passion for their dreams,
and their sheer tenacity to overcome any obstacle..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I take into account factors that give rise to such historical drama.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ai-san's Genesis Factor back then was—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
First, the high expectations from Japan.
Among the Genesis Factors,
this is the most critical element to consider.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"And then, the motivation of my first overseas expedition,
and the wave of peak condition coming off a world record."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I think it'd be good to also add the drama of being the absolute powerhouse that every other runner sees as their rival.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"When this many factors align...
it reaches the level of 'historical inevitability.'"
choice_data_list: True... we did win, didn't we!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. When abilities are evenly matched,
the key to victory lies in the Genesis Factor.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
To seize victory...
and to weave a historical drama, it is an essential element...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...As I am right now, I still
do not possess such things—"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I must also become capable of
obtaining the Genesis Factor...!

—Final preparations for the Oka Sho.
Chrono Genesis's conditioning was proceeding smoothly.
choice_data_list: Yeah, your time looked great too!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: At Hanshin, the steep hill right after the downhill before the finish line makes it tough to run.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Remembering how the Asahi Hai felt...
Hmmmm...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: —Alright, I can picture it now!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (Gran-chan, what a powerful stride...!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (...No! If I give up mentally, then I've truly lost...!)
choice_data_list: Chrono, can you go for one more?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Please do!

The day of the main event. Ahead of the Oka Sho,
in the 9th race, the Wasurenagusa Sho—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You pulls away from the pack!
Two lengths, three lengths... A runaway victory!!
Loves Only You won convincingly by three lengths.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... My legs are in perfect condition!
I'm ready for the Oaks...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Now I can compete with my peers!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (Love-chan... grabbed a solid victory, gaining great momentum heading into the Oaks...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...I will win this race with certainty.
And connect it to the Oaks..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Because this single step will make or break
the reputation of our entire generation...!
choice_data_list: (...Chrono is putting way too much pressure on herself.)
(...Chrono is putting way too much pressure on herself.)

text_block_list.text: Perhaps it was the weight of the Oka Sho title. Chrono Genesis was clearly fired up far too much.
If this continues, she might end up rushing.
choice_data_list: ...Hey Chrono, can I ask you something?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes, what is it?
choice_data_list: Tell me your ideas for the Oka Sho column.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: A column...?
choice_data_list: Yeah. Because I forgot my lucky charm today.

text_block_list.text:
There shouldn't have been any articles about the Oka Sho
in her column before.
That's why I didn't bring the school newspaper today.

Chrono Genesis's clear eyes gaze intently at me.
...Was I being far too unnatural after all?
And then—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "...That Umamusume may have placed second in her debut, but she possessed a strength acknowledged even by renowned trainers."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Victory in the Oka Sho was certain—she even declared it with such confidence in her interview.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "We should be able to win—so long as we don't draw the outermost gate."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "And for the Oka Sho, the gate she drew was Bracket 8—the outermost gate."
choice_data_list: Now that's some impressive flag payoff!
Now that was a perfect flag recovery!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Back then—before the renovations at Hanshin Racecourse—the layout made it quite difficult to secure a good position from the outside gates.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Come race day, she... missed the start.
However, due to a blistering pace known as the "Cursed Oka Sho Pace,"
the front-runners stalled out.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: On the final straight, she surged from behind with a brilliant burst of speed, claiming the Oka Sho tiara.
choice_data_list: I don't know if I'd call it dramatic, but it sure is interesting!
Dramatic or not, it's pretty interesting!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Drawing the outermost gate and missing the start were unexpected,
but in the end, it worked in our favor.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...That's right. Even if you make a mistake,
there's always a way to recover...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Historically speaking, those who maintain a bold stance
tend to come out victorious. For example..."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if an Umamusume on the level of Almond Eye
will show up on the Tiara circuit this year?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (...The Triple Tiara races have a unique atmosphere, swirling with so much anticipation...)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: My Rule! "Skip if you're itching to run before a race"!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Hmm hum hum~♪

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, she's humming?!
Talk about nerves of steel, Gran Alegria!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Actually, she might be a big deal, you know?
She set a record in her debut race, after all.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I'm aiming for the record today too!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "I'll show you a run that surpasses even Ai-senpai!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Haha, I like your spirit, but a GⅠ record isn't gonna be broken that easily—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Shall I bring it out?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Because the Oka Sho is 1,600 meters.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm Gran Alegria,
the mile genius!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...!
......She's serious...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: If you're that confident... could it really be...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (! The atmosphere... changed...)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Hey!
What about you, Chrono-chan?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: M-Me...? Is it really me...?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: It's the dream stage of the Triple Tiara, after all!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Y-Yes. I-I also...—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...With my running,
I fully intend to forge a whole new era...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, let's make this the greatest Oka Sho in history,
Chrono-chan!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(Gran-chan's
Genesis Factor is—)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (A level of confidence so overwhelming it completely swallows the audience...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (A genius formidable enough to back that up...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (And the mile distance.)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (Such sheer talent for the mile—that alone puts her factor on par with Ms. Ai!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (It is already... "inevitable".)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (History is about to choose Gran-chan.)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I have to overturn it...!
Even if that is what history decided—!
